title: Text 4
subtitle: 新西兰劳动法下的解雇之争

sentences.en: The personal grievance provisions of New Zealand’s Employment Relations Act 2000 (ERA) prevent an employer from firing an employee without good cause.
sentences.zh: 新西兰《2000年雇佣关系法》中的个人申诉条款规定，雇主若无正当理由，不得解雇员工。

sentences.en: Instead, dismissals must be justified.
sentences.zh: 相反，解雇必须有正当理由。

sentences.en: Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.
sentences.zh: 雇主既要说明解雇理由，又要按照正当的程序行事。

sentences.en: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from “unjustified dismissals”.
sentences.zh: 个人申诉程序的设立旨在保护普通工人的工作岗位免遭“无正当理由的解雇”。

sentences.en: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.
sentences.zh: 其前提是，普通合同法缺乏足够的保障措施来保护工人免受管理层的专断行为之害。

sentences.en: Long gone are the days when a boss could simply give an employee contractual notice.
sentences.zh: 老板只需按合同向员工发出解雇通知就能将其辞退的日子已经一去不复返了。

sentences.en: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives.
sentences.zh: 但当这些条款适用于高薪经理和高管时，就会给企业带来麻烦。

sentences.en: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance.
sentences.zh: 无数董事会和企业主都可以证明，限制企业解雇业绩不佳的高薪经理，犹如给提高生产率和整体业绩踩了刹车。

sentences.en: The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure.
sentences.zh: C级经理与A级经理之间的差别，很可能就是企业成功与失败的差别。

sentences.en: Between preserving the jobs of ordinary workers or losing them.
sentences.zh: 就是保住普通工人的饭碗还是丢掉他们的饭碗的差别。

sentences.en: Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
sentences.zh: 然而，表现平庸已不再足以成为解雇的理由。

sentences.en: Consequently—and paradoxically—laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.
sentences.zh: 因此——而且矛盾的是——为保护普通工人饭碗而制定的法律，可能正在将这些饭碗置于危险之中。

sentences.en: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers’ wages.
sentences.zh: 即使没有使工作岗位面临风险，只要就业保护法限制了企业主解雇表现不佳的经理，这些法律就会制约企业的生产率，进而制约工人的工资。

sentences.en: Indeed, in “An International Perspective on New Zealand’s Productivity Paradox” (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country’s poor productivity growth record.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在《新西兰生产率悖论的国际视角》（2014年）一文中，新西兰生产力委员会明确指出，管理能力低下是该国生产率增长乏力的一个原因。

sentences.en: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA’s unjustified dismissal procedures.
sentences.zh: 高薪经理们自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中“无正当理由解雇”程序所带来的伤害。

sentences.en: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff.
sentences.zh: 由于就业保护法提高了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时也更加谨慎。

sentences.en: This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment.
sentences.zh: 这使那些能力平庸的边缘经理更难找到工作。

sentences.en: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于企业要承担雇佣安排出错的后果，企业支付的薪酬也更低。

sentences.en: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections.
sentences.zh: 过度的就业保护还会使整个社会深受其害。

sentences.en: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
sentences.zh: 严格的解雇法规会对生产率增长产生不利影响，并妨碍社会繁荣和整体福祉。

sentences.en: Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified “high-income threshold” from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws.
sentences.zh: 在塔斯曼海对岸的澳大利亚，该国通过将收入超过特定“高收入门槛”的员工排除在“不公平解雇”法律保护之外的方式，来应对“无正当理由解雇”这一悖论。

sentences.en: In New Zealand, a 2016 private members’ Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime.
sentences.zh: 在新西兰，2016年的一项议员个人提案试图允许企业和高收入员工通过签订合同来规避“无正当理由解雇”制度。

sentences.en: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
sentences.zh: 然而，拟议的机制操作起来过于笨拙，该法案在当年晚些时候政府换届后被否决了。

questions.stem: The personal grievance provisions of the ERA are intended to ______.

options.D: protect the rights of ordinary workers

questions.analysis: 首两段指出 ERA 个人冤情条款旨在保护普通工人免遭“不公正解雇”，因为普通法契约对管理层随意行为缺乏足够保障。

questions.stem: It can be learned from paragraph 3 that the provisions may ______.

options.C: affect the public image of the firms

questions.analysis: 第三段指出这些条款对企业形成约束，阻碍解雇绩效差的高薪经理，成为提升生产率的“手刹”（a handbrake on boosting productivity），即阻碍企业发展。

questions.stem: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?

options.C: Limiting the powers of business owners.

questions.analysis: 第六段提到生产力委员会把“管理能力低下”列为新西兰生产率增长不佳的原因（singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities），暗示其支持淘汰绩效不佳的经理。

questions.stem: What might be an effect of ERA’s unjustified dismissal procedures?

options.A: Highly paid managers lose their jobs.
options.C: Society sees a rise in overall well-being.
options.D: Employers need to hire new staff.

questions.analysis: 第七段称保护法使解雇更贵、雇主招聘更谨慎，且公司因承担雇佣安排出错的风险而支付更少工资（firms pay staff less），即员工面临降薪。

questions.stem: It can be inferred that the “high-income threshold” in Australia ______.

options.D: is difficult to put into practice

questions.analysis: 末段说澳大利亚用“高收入门槛”解决这一悖论；新西兰 2016 年私人法案效仿，但机制“笨重”（unwieldy）而未被通过，说明门槛难以付诸实践。
